# Tectonic

Clip bundles the official macOS arm64 build of Tectonic 0.16.9 for LaTeX
compilation in both distribution channels.

Run `Scripts/vendor-tectonic.sh` to download the pinned release archive, verify
its SHA-256 digest, confirm its architecture, and install the executable into
TextEngine's resources. The executable itself is stored with Git LFS.

Source: <https://github.com/tectonic-typesetting/tectonic/releases/tag/tectonic%400.16.9>
